mapper.select: select se.id as seasonId, se.display_title as seasonTitle, s.series_code as seriesCode, s.series_name as seriesName, d.id as divisionId, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, et.id as eventTeamId, et.team_name_snapshot as teamName, et.team_logo_file_id as teamLogoFileId, case when ep.is_captain = 1 then 'CAPTAIN' else 'PLAYER' end as roleInTeam, et.event_team_status as eventTeamStatus, d.division_status as divisionStatus, (select count(1) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id)) as matchCount, (select count(1) from basket_match m where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status = 'FINISHED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id)) as finishedMatchCount, (select count(1) from basket_match m left join ( select s1.match_id, s1.submit_event_team_id, s1.submission_status from basket_match_submission s1 join ( select match_id, submit_event_team_id, max(version_no) as max_ver from basket_match_submission where is_delete = 0 group by match_id, submit_event_team_id ) lv on lv.match_id = s1.match_id and lv.submit_event_team_id = s1.submit_event_team_id and lv.max_ver = s1.version_no where s1.is_delete = 0 ) ps on ps.match_id = m.id and ps.submit_event_team_id = et.id where m.is_delete = 0 and m.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' and m.match_status != 'CANCELLED' and (m.home_event_team_id = et.id or m.away_event_team_id = et.id) and (ps.submission_status is null or ps.submission_status in ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')) ) as pendingSubmissionCount from basket_event_player ep inner join basket_event_team et on et.id = ep.event_team_id and et.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_division d on d.id = et.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_season se on se.id = et.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 inner join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 where ep.is_delete = 0 and (ep.member_id = #{memberId} or ep.source_player_id = #{playerId}) group by et.id, ep.is_captain order by se.id desc, d.sort_order asc, et.id desc
